commonFailures: Thread galling (cold welding) when titanium threads mate without anti-seize compound

faq.q: How is a titanium threaded rod (1m) manufactured?
faq.a: A typical titanium threaded rod (1m) is manufactured using Cold heading; Thread rolling (DIN 13-1); Heat treatment; Passivation. BOZE CNC Ti uses precision CNC equipment with strict process controls to ensure consistent quality and dimensional accuracy.

faq.q: What are the alternatives to Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V for titanium threaded rod (1m)?
faq.a: Alternative materials include stainless steel (heavier, susceptible to corrosion) and aluminum (lower strength, shorter fatigue life). The alternative manufacturing method is Cut (machined) threads (reduces fatigue life by 200% due to interrupted grain flow).

faq.q: What standards apply to titanium threaded rod (1m)?
faq.a: Titanium Threaded Rod (1m) components are typically manufactured to ASTM B348, ASME. Additional customer-specific specifications may apply.

faq.q: What are common failure modes for titanium threaded rod (1m)?
faq.a: Common failure modes include Thread galling (cold welding) when titanium threads mate without anti-seize compound. BOZE CNC Ti mitigates these through strict process control, proper material selection, and 100% inspection.

faq.q: What is the typical lead time for custom titanium threaded rod (1m)?
faq.a: Standard lead time is 2-4 weeks depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders can be accommodated. Contact our sales team for specific delivery schedules.
